title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
hook_text: Microsoft Azure hits thirty three billion
script:
Microsoft just revealed that Azure generated thirty three point two billion dollars.
This is the first time the company has ever shared the exact quarterly dollar amount for its cloud platform.
The record figure shows just how close the platform is getting to besting Amazon Web Services in the market.
Heavy enterprise spending on generative workloads is driving this massive growth in cloud infrastructure.
Competitor Amazon Web Services previously held an uncontested lead in total quarterly cloud sales.
Can Microsoft overtake Amazon in the global cloud market this year?
